findings.passage: Our elections only work because of the people who run them. In recent years, election workers and voters have felt threatened when all they wanted to do was their job or their civic duty. We need to look at all of the options for ensuring our elections are conducted safely.
findings.note: Emailed statement quoted by The Nevada Independent. The story says he was thankful to the Assemblywoman for AB354, which would make it a crime to bring a gun within 100 yards of an election site. The quote itself does not mention guns.
